title: User inconvenience
body: This app has really helped me with my studying and my productivity, however when you reenter the app, the interval timer fully resets and so does the music — which can get very irritating.
author: Tyking8907

title: Meh
body: The music's unfortunately quite bad. At best like elevator music, at worst like... ringtones
author: Justin Timeout

title: Deceptive signup tactics
body:
Really disappointed to be starting off things with such a negative experience before I even used the app or tired the ADHD minimization effects the app claims to offer. 

I signed up for the seven day free trial with the monthly cost of R89.99 but instead was immediately charged R139.99 instead of after the trial period. Shocking behavior!

Now that I’ve paid and extra 50% above what I was prepared to pay, I’ll give the app a try but I have to be honest, this experience has left me feeling cheated; especially about the massive price difference.
author: SomebodyThatYouUsedToKn0w

title: Buggy
body: I really like this app but it literally refuses to work.
author: Chantal Davel

title: Janky tones
body:
Music was janky and jarring.. hard to listen to. Interface and app seems good enough, easy to manage, love that you can set a timer on how long to listen to sleep music. 
Just.. couldn’t listen to the Focus tones.. kind of defeating the purpose.
author: OoblyDoobly

title: Review
body: You guys actually changed my life, will forever be thankful
author: Esané

title: So far so good
body: I’ve only been using the app for a week. I’m a reporter with burnout so focusing has been a real challenge the last couple of months. So far, this app has helped A LOT to keep me focused. I love that you can switch between genres of music and different focus modes. My brain gets bored real fast but so far I haven’t heard one song twice and I use the app all day.
author: Ginx_L

title: Care of the trial
body:
Did not me notify of end of the trail and auto charged my credit card for the year. Not cool. 
App doesn’t work for me, music too wobbly , ends up distracting me more than helping.
author: tatkinsza

title: Been a Customer for 3 years
body: Been using BrainFM for 3 years. Can’t work without it. Have like a 67 week streak with them lol. Also love how affordable their pricing is. Hopefully that doesn’t change this as they gain more traction online.
author: Reeve.S

title: App crashing constantly
body: Your app has been crashing on my phone for 2 weeks now. Do you expect me to pay a subscription for a service you aren’t offering? Sort it out
author: BCStew78

title: Not working after the last update
body: I am running IOS 18.1.1. On an iPhone 13.  After the last update as soon as you click on the app to open it, it closes immediately.
author: Tryingtoupdatedetails

title: The same bugs continue to affect the functionality after repeated updates.
body: I am unable to use the timer function on my iPhone 13 Pro Max when I am listening to downloaded content when offline.  I have to use apple’s IOS timer instead.  The timer does not countdown on your app after applying the preferable amount of time.   Your “Send Us feedback” page on the app doesn’t work either, as you cannot send the message thats been written.  Hence I have had to add it to this review section for your attention.  Please work out these pesky bugs that are taking away from what could be a great app.
author: Wordser100

title: Focus Booster!!
body: It’s so much easier now to sit for 2 - 3 hours and focus on a task with this music in the background. It is so easy to get lost in the loop of the music, forget everything else that exists outside, and focus on the task at hand whether it’s walking outside, writing code, or completing some work assignment. Best app find ever
author: Sosa-Sosars

title: Incredible
body:
As a student who taught herself Cambridge A levels, getting into the zone easily was one of my toughest challenges and I my only wish would be to have found this app just a month sooner. 

 What they have managed to accomplish simply with sound from your device is truly incredible.
author: Smile ~(^v^)~

title: Works as advertised
body:
It does what it says on the box. It's so easy. There are no interruptions. 
I would like dark mode (instead of purple in a dark room) and some kind of Siri or Shortcuts integration and a few widgets for 5 stars.
author: Magicofmohamed

title: Love Brain.fm. Definitely works!
body:
I have been using Brain.fm on and off since 2016. It takes some getting used to because it is unlike anything else you’ll listen to. 

It gave me such amazing results that I used try to listen to it all day but this caused me to feel very drained and even dizzy! 

I have now learnt to pace myself and I use it interchangeably with other music and it does a fantastic job. Works every time to get me to into a flow state! After 30mins of focus music I will change to regular lofi music and after lunch (or when I start to feel distracted) I listen to another 30mins of Brain.fm focus music and I’m back in the flow. 

I would recommend this app to anyone who wants to focus and get into a flow state. My productivity has been much better since using Brain.fm.
author: heyJobel

title: Impossible to cancel
body: Won’t let me cancel. Dangerous!
author: djm12673

title: Great app
body: Enjoying this app! Heard about it while reading a Tim Ferris book. It’s helped me study, and focus for extended periods of time. At first, it takes some time to get the right music for best focus as the app is working to give you optimal music. Once it does, the music is spot on for either focus for reading, creative work or deep work. And it also has music for sleep, meditation and relaxing. I’ve found that the sleep sounds are also more accurate than other apps I have used before. Highly recommend !
author: postmodernexplorer

title: Excellent for ADHD
body: As an adult with ADHD, I struggle to concentrate , even with music and normal classical music. This app however has helped me hyper focus, i love the nap/recharge sessions and the sleep sessions too.  If you need help blocking out distractions, this is just for you!!
author: sar82100000

title: Great for focused work
body: Great app! Really helps me get in the zone while working. I appreciate that they’re contestants adding new music 😊
author: RMGoetsch

title: Best App ever
body: Absolutely luv this App and wouldn’t know what to do without it. Best sounds ever
author: KerryBayvel

title: Great App with Great Content.
body: Great app and streaming service. The music engine is constantly updated and new sound-spheres added. Music for focus, relaxation, meditation and even sleep. For the price it’s an absolute no brainer.
author: Tyron Stephen

title: Effective at blocking distractions
body: Really does seem to do what it says on the tin.

title: A great way to organise my workload
body: Not only a great way to help keep my focus but I also now use it to schedule work that needs to get done and force myself to complete tasks in allocated times/sessions as set in Brain.fm app.

Try it and see for yourself...
